description: Anthill desktop shell: run the backend sidecar, navigate the window to the local server, and self-update. The window loads the backend over http://127.0.0.1:<free-port>/<path>, so IPC (the open_profile command) is scoped to that local origin below. open_profile is an app command: Tauri only lets a remote origin call it if build.rs declares it in the app manifest (that generates the allow-open-profile permission) AND it is listed here - miss either and the packaged app fails with "Command open_profile not allowed by ACL". The urls MUST carry a path wildcard (/**) - a Tauri v2 remote glob with no path matches nothing, so the invoke was silently dropped before reaching Rust (issue #388, tauri-apps/tauri#11622).
